Direct frame inspection at 59350-59365s confirms the actual in-game boss health-bar text reads '毒敌大王' (Poison Enemy Great King) -- the captioning pipeline mislabeled the boss name. root_causes: Captioning/labeling error: the boss-name banner visible on-screen at 59340-59370s was auto-captioned as '金箍大王' instead of the correct '毒敌大王', so every text-retrieval pass that found the right time window discarded it as a non-match.

All 5 rollouts, after rejecting the correct window, converged on the same wrong later scene (~62100-62600s, an unrelated scorpion/centipede boss fight) purely because it thematically resembled 'poison enemy' -- a case of the whole cohort making a correlated retrieval error rather than five independent visual misreads.

transferable_lessons: When a boss/entity name in the question fails to lexically match any caption text near an otherwise well-matching time window (right scene type, right narrative beats), do not assume the window is wrong -- caption/OCR errors on in-game name banners are common; verify with clip_qa before abandoning a strong temporal/contextual match.

Prefer trusting a temporally well-corroborated event/topic window (boss confrontation right after equipping incantations, matching the narrative flow) over a strict string match on a proper noun that could be a captioning artifact.

For 'what did the player use/equip' visual-HUD questions, clip_qa should be run on the specific candidate window as soon as it's found, before spending further budget on broader semantic search that can drift to a different, superficially similar scene.

When multiple broad semantic searches for a specific proper noun (毒敌大王) all fail to find it verbatim, treat that as evidence the term might be mis-transcribed elsewhere in the DB, not as proof the window is wrong.
